title: Advice from founders: Atomic's write-up of Ryan Hoover on community, PMF and party rounds
summary: A third-party Atomic blog post paraphrasing a conversation with Ryan Hoover. It covers building community into a product from day one, product-market fit as a bumpy but systematic search, not bending your product to investor trends, focusing on a narrow early customer base, and party rounds. Ryan is not quoted directly; it is Atomic's summary, so no verbatim principles can be extracted.
